description: Walk out from the entities you name: every entity within depth hops, with the relations that touch them. Use it instead of read_graph to assemble the context around a topic, and instead of open_nodes when the neighbours' content matters as much as the entity you started from. The walk ignores direction, stops on cycles, and skips names that do not exist rather than failing. When limit binds, truncated is true and the farthest entities are the ones left out.

depth.description: How many hops to walk, 1 by default and at most 5

limit.description: The most entities to return, 200 by default

name: expand_nodes

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

title: Expand Nodes
